prompt: [curious, energetic, slightly eerie] If this parasite gets inside a snail, it can turn its eyes into MOVING BAIT. [brisk, explaining] The worm grows through its body and fills its eyestalks with pulsing, colorful sacs. [eerie, fascinated] They start looking like tiny CATERPILLARS. [knowing] And that's exactly what the parasite wants. [building] Because when a BIRD spots one and eats it, the parasite gets inside the bird. [quieter, eerie] Then its eggs spread through the bird's droppings, ready to infect another snail.
prompt_note: The approved words, verbatim (production/NARRATION_LOCKED.txt). Capitals mark the brief's three emphasis words; the bracket tags direct delivery and are not spoken.
generated_once: One run of two variations (the connector default), 2 x 522.9 credits. No regeneration.

takes.asr: zipformer and whisper base.en: only spelling differences (eye stalks, sacks)

takes.why_not: whisper hears a sentence break before 'ready' (droppings. ready), a weaker 'bird' (+5.0 dB) and a fainter last 'snail' (-8.8 dB vs -5.0 dB)

edits: None. The take is used sample for sample: no gap edits, no time-stretch, no pitch change. A 0.6 s tail after the last word carries the push into the loop.
